name: As white as a sheet/as white as a ghost

meaning.zh:
“脸色苍白” 或 “面无血色”。

这个短语源自形容一个人因惊吓、病痛或惊讶而脸色变得非常苍白，就像一张白纸或幽灵一样。通常用来描述因为某种原因而丧失血色的情况。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the comparison of someone's face turning very pale due to fear, illness, or shock, likening it to the whiteness of a sheet or a ghost. It is commonly used to describe someone who looks bloodless for some reason.

lines.en: When she heard the news, she turned *as white as a sheet*.
lines.zh: 听到这个消息，她脸色变得苍白。

lines.en: He looked *as white as a ghost* after walking out of the haunted house.
lines.zh: 从鬼屋出来后，他看起来面无血色。

lines.en: The sudden fright made him go *as white as a sheet*.
lines.zh: 突如其来的惊吓让他的脸色变得苍白。
